fields.Name: SubQ Snap
fields.Description: Subquadratic's multimodal decision model, built for fast, long-context decisions in enterprise agentic workflows. Announced on October 12, 2026, it is in public preview as subq-snap-preview; Subquadratic will change that ID at general availability, so update the Inference Provider row's APIName then. Its only host is the SubQ Decisions API (POST https://api.subq.ai/v1/systemone), which takes the same System One request as Jev: Likelihood, Choice (2 to 255 options) and Score (2 to 10 levels) questions about one state, named with up to 100 characters, each answered with a probability for every option or level. It writes no text. Subquadratic's announcement gives up to 384K tokens of context; its API documentation gives no limit. The API also accepts up to 4 images with the state, which MJ does not send yet. It charges $0.05 per million input tokens; output is free. MJ has not measured it; Subquadratic's claims are its own. Its raw probabilities are not calibrated to MJ's data, so set thresholds on calibrated values.
